iterations.theme: Uvodne molitve, Krunica i Litanije Božjem milosrđu te Gospina krunica (otajstva svjetla)

sections.subtitle: Uvod u molitvu: evanđelje o proroku koji ne smije poginuti izvan Jeruzalema
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj pozdravlja gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora i najavljuje evanđelje dana
sections.content:
Emisija medija **Ora et Labora** iz Međugorja, koju prema službenim metapodacima priprema dr. sc. Vladimir Grebenar, bacc. theol., počinje kratkim pozdravom „gospodi, dragim gledateljima i slušateljima“. Voditelj odmah najavljuje misao vodilju dana. Evanđelje dana nosi rečenicu: **„Ne priliči da prorok pogine izvan Jeruzalema.“**

Nakon te najave nema dodatnih objašnjenja. Voditelj se prekriži zazivom „U ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga“ i time otvara dugi molitveni blok. Taj blok prethodi tumačenju Svetoga pisma i u ovoj epizodi traje više od pola sata. Evanđelje najavljeno na početku tako ostaje u pozadini cijelog molitvenog dijela, kao tema kojoj će se emisija vratiti tek kasnije.
sections.subtitle_en: Introduction to prayer: the gospel of the prophet who must not perish outside of Jerusalem
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host greets viewers and listeners of the media Ora et Labora and announces the gospel of the day
sections.content_en:
The broadcast of the media **Ora et Labora** from Međugorje, which according to official metadata is prepared by Dr. Vladimir Grebenar, Bacc. Theol., begins with a short greeting to "the gentlemen, dear viewers, and listeners." The host immediately announces the guiding thought of the day. The gospel of the day carries the sentence: **"It is impossible that a prophet should perish outside of Jerusalem."**

After that announcement, there are no additional explanations. The host crosses himself with the invocation "In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit" and thereby opens a long prayer block. That block precedes the interpretation of Sacred Scripture and in this episode lasts more than half an hour. The gospel announced at the beginning thus remains in the background of the entire prayer part, as a topic to which the broadcast will return only later.

sections.subtitle: Molitva oslobođenja: „vežem sve zle sile i snage“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara molitvu oslobođenja i zaštite od zlih sila
sections.content:
Prvi dio molitvenog bloka je **molitva oslobođenja i zaštite**. Voditelj u ime Isusovo „uzima vlast“ i veže sve zle sile i snage. Pritom ih detaljno nabraja prema prostorima u kojima mogu djelovati:

- u zraku i na zemlji,
- u vodi i u podzemlju,
- na onome svijetu,
- u prirodi i u vatri.

Nakon toga molitva prelazi u hvalu. Gospodin se ispovijeda kao „Gospodin nad svim svemirom“, a slava mu se daje „u ime njegova stvorenja“. Voditelj zatim u Božje ime veže sve demonske sile koje su „došle protiv nas i naših obitelji“. Sve okupljene stavlja pod zaštitu **dragocjene krvi** prolivene na križu.

U molitvu su uključeni i nebeski zagovornici. Od Marije se, kao majke, traži zaštita i zagovor kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve obitelji, uz molbu: „Zaogrni nas svojim plaštem ljubavi, da se prestraši neprijatelj.“ Sveti Mihovil i anđeli čuvari pozvani su da brane obitelji u borbi protiv zla „što obilazi svijetom“.

Vrhunac ovog dijela je izravna zapovijed. U ime Isusovo voditelj zapovijeda svim silama i snagama zla da „odstupe istog časa“ od prisutnih, njihovih domova i njihove zemlje. Molitva završava zahvalom Isusu kao „vjernom Bogu“ koji „osjeća s nama“.
sections.subtitle_en: Deliverance prayer: "I bind all evil forces and powers"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host speaks the prayer of deliverance and protection against evil powers
sections.content_en:
The first part of the prayer block is the **prayer of deliverance and protection**. The host in the name of Jesus "takes authority" and binds all evil forces and powers. In doing so, he enumerates them in detail according to the realms in which they can act:

- in the air and on the earth,
- in the water and in the underworld,
- in the next world,
- in nature and in fire.

After that, the prayer turns into praise. The Lord is confessed as "Lord over the entire universe," and glory is given to him "in the name of his creation." The host then in the name of God binds all demonic forces that have "come against us and our families." He places all those gathered under the protection of the **precious blood** shed on the cross.

Heavenly intercessors are also included in the prayer. Protection and intercession at the Sacred Heart of Jesus for all families are sought from Mary, as a mother, with the petition: "Cover us with your mantle of love, so that the enemy may be terrified." Saint Michael and the guardian angels are called upon to defend families in the battle against evil "that prowls about the world."

The climax of this part is a direct command. In the name of Jesus, the host commands all forces and powers of evil to "depart immediately" from those present, their homes, and their land. The prayer ends with thanksgiving to Jesus as the "faithful God" who "feels with us."

sections.subtitle: Sveti Mihael i molitva jedinstva: „neka naša srca kucaju zajedno“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli molitvu jedinstva s Isusom
sections.content:
Slijedi tradicionalna **molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. U njoj se on zaziva kao zaštitnik „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“. Molitvom se ponizno traži da „vojvoda vojske nebeske“ božanskom krijepošću i jakošću u pakao strovali Sotonu i druge zlobne duhove „koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša“.

Ratnički ton zatim se zamjenjuje nježnijim. Voditelj moli **molitvu jedinstva s Isusom**, kojom se vjernik obraća „ljupkom Isusu“. Molitva je građena kao niz zaziva koji jedan za drugim opisuju potpuno zajedništvo s Kristom:

- neka noge zajedno hode,
- neka ruke budu skupljene u jedinstvu,
- neka srca kucaju zajedno,
- neka duše budu u skladu, a misli kao jedno,
- neka uši zajedno slušaju tišinu,
- neka pogledi duboko prodru jedan u drugi,
- neka usne zajedno mole.

Cilj tog jedinstva izrečen je na kraju: da se „zadobije milosrđe od vječnoga Oca“. Time se najavljuje središnja tema cijele epizode, a to je Božje milosrđe.
sections.subtitle_en: Saint Michael and the prayer of unity: "may our hearts beat together"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the prayer of unity with Jesus
sections.content_en:
There follows the traditional **prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel**. In it, he is invoked as protector "in the battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil." The prayer humbly asks that the "prince of the heavenly host," by divine virtue and power, cast into hell Satan and the other evil spirits "who prowl about the world seeking the ruin of souls."

The combative tone is then replaced by a gentler one. The host prays the **prayer of unity with Jesus**, by which the believer addresses "sweet Jesus." The prayer is constructed as a series of invocations that describe complete communion with Christ one after another:

- may feet walk together,
- may hands be gathered in unity,
- may hearts beat together,
- may souls be in harmony, and thoughts as one,
- may ears listen together to the silence,
- may gazes deeply penetrate one another,
- may lips pray together.

The goal of this unity is expressed at the end: to "obtain mercy from the eternal Father." This announces the central theme of the entire episode, which is Divine Mercy.

sections.subtitle: Dvije posvete: Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Uvodne molitve zaključuju se dvjema posvetama. Prva je **posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu**. U njoj vjernik Presvetoj Djevici, „majci i kraljici“, predaje „čitavo svoje biće, sve misli, riječi i djela“. Mariji dopušta da raspolaže njime i svime što mu pripada, „sada i u vječnosti“. Posveta ima tri navedene svrhe: hvalu i slavu Presvetoga Trojstva, posvećenje Crkve i spasenje svega svijeta.

U drugom dijelu posvete molitelj traži pomoć da živi dostojno svoga **krsnog posvećenja**, kako bi „neopozivo pripadao“ svome Otkupitelju. Moli i da poput Marije sluša poticaje Duha Svetoga te da se u njemu i u svemu vrši volja Božja.

Druga je **posveta Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**, koje se naziva „izvorom svakoga dobra“. Vjernik se ovdje klanja, ispovijeda vjeru, ufanje i ljubav te se kaje za svoje grijehe. Isusu poklanja svoje „siromašno srce“ i moli da ga učini poniznim, strpljivim i čistim, da u svemu odgovara Njegovim željama. Uz molbu „da ja živim u tebi i ti u meni“ dolaze i konkretne potrebe:

- zaštita u opasnostima,
- utjeha u nevoljama i žalostima,
- zdravlje tijela,
- blagoslov za sav rad,
- milost svete smrti.
sections.subtitle_en: Two consecrations: to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Sacred Heart of Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host pronounces the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
The opening prayers conclude with two consecrations. The first is the **consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary**. In it, the believer surrenders to the Blessed Virgin, "mother and queen," "one's entire being, all thoughts, words, and deeds." The believer permits Mary to dispose of him and of all that belongs to him, "now and in eternity." The consecration has three stated purposes: the praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity, the sanctification of the Church, and the salvation of the whole world.

In the second part of the consecration, the petitioner asks for help to live worthily of one's **baptismal consecration**, in order to "belong irrevocably" to one's Redeemer. He also prays that, like Mary, he may listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit and that in him and in everything the will of God may be done.

The second is the **consecration to the Sacred Heart of Jesus**, which is called "the source of every good." Here the believer adores, professes faith, hope, and love, and repents for his sins. He presents his "poor heart" to Jesus and prays that He make it humble, patient, and pure, conforming in everything to His desires. Along with the petition "that I may live in you and you in me" come concrete needs as well:

- protection in dangers,
- consolation in afflictions and sorrows,
- health of the body,
- blessing for all work,
- the grace of a holy death.

sections.subtitle: Krunica Božjega milosrđa: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci...“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj na početku desetice Krunice Božjega milosrđa prikazuje Ocu tijelo i krv Kristovu
sections.content:
Na 3. minuti i 42. sekundi voditelj najavljuje **Krunicu Božjega milosrđa**. Ona i daje ime epizodi „Milosrđe Božje“. Krunica počinje uobičajenim molitvama: Očenašem, Zdravomarijom i Apostolskim vjerovanjem. U Vjerovanju se ispovijeda vjera u Boga Oca Stvoritelja, u Isusa Krista „mučena pod Poncijem Pilatom“, raspeta, umrla, pokopana i uskrsla, te u Duha Svetoga, Crkvu, općinstvo svetih, oproštenje grijeha, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.

Srž ove krunice su desetice koje se otvaraju zazivom upućenim Ocu:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“

Nakon toga deset puta se ponavlja kratki zaziv: **„Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“** Voditelj kroz pet desetica mirno ponavlja isti obrazac. Od otprilike 5. do 11. minute emisija tako gotovo posve prelazi u ritam meditativnog ponavljanja.

U ovoj molitvi naglasak nije na raznolikosti riječi nego na ustrajnosti. Iznova se podsjeća na Kristovu muku kao temelj na kojem molitelj traži milosrđe, i to ne samo za sebe nego „za cijeli svijet“.
sections.subtitle_en: Chaplet of Divine Mercy: "For the sake of His sorrowful Passion..."
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host at the beginning of a decade of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy offers the body and blood of Christ to the Father
sections.content_en:
At 3 minutes and 42 seconds, the host announces the **Chaplet of Divine Mercy**. It gives its name to the episode "Divine Mercy." The Chaplet begins with the customary prayers: the Our Father, the Hail Mary, and the Apostles' Creed. In the Creed, faith is professed in God the Father Creator, in Jesus Christ "suffered under Pontius Pilate," crucified, died, buried, and resurrected, and in the Holy Spirit, the Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

The core of this chaplet is the decades that open with an invocation addressed to the Father:

> "Eternal Father, we offer you the body and blood, soul and divinity of your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world."

After that, the short invocation is repeated ten times: **"For the sake of his sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world."** The host calmly repeats the same pattern through five decades. From roughly the 5th to the 11th minute, the broadcast thus shifts almost entirely into the rhythm of meditative repetition.

In this prayer, the emphasis is not on diversity of words, but on perseverance. Again and again, Christ's Passion is recalled as the foundation on which the petitioner asks for mercy, and that not only for oneself, but "for the whole world."

sections.subtitle: „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože“ i trostruko „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj triput moli zaziv „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože“
sections.content:
Krunica milosrđa završava trostrukim zazivom: **„Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu.“** Zaziv se svečano ponavlja tri puta.

Zatim voditelj moli zaziv upućen Kristovu probodenom boku:

> „O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz srca Isusova, kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“

Slijedi zaziv Mariji kao **majci milosrđa**: „Marijo, majko milosrđa, moli za nas.“ Dio završava tri puta ponovljenim i jednostavnim izrazom predanja: **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe.“** Krunica se zaključuje molbom „Smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu, Gospodine.“ Taj obrat od molbe prema pouzdanju zatim se izravno nastavlja u litanijama.
sections.subtitle_en: "Holy God, Holy Mighty God" and the threefold "Jesus, I trust in You"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays three times the invocation "Holy God, Holy Mighty God, Holy Immortal God"
sections.content_en:
The Chaplet of Mercy concludes with the threefold invocation: **"Holy God, Holy Mighty God, Holy Immortal God, have mercy on us and on the whole world."** The invocation is solemnly repeated three times.

Then the host prays the invocation addressed to Christ's pierced side:

> "O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fount of Mercy for us, I trust in You."

There follows the invocation to Mary as **mother of mercy**: "Mary, mother of mercy, pray for us." The section concludes with the threefold repeated and simple expression of surrender: **"Jesus, I trust in you."** The Chaplet concludes with the petition "Have mercy on us and on the whole world, Lord." That turn from petition toward trust then continues directly into the litany.

sections.subtitle: Litanije Božjem milosrđu: od stvaranja do čistilišta
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj predmoli litanije Božjem milosrđu i ponavlja „uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Na 12. minuti i 33. sekundi počinju **Litanije Božjem milosrđu**. Otvaraju se klasičnim zazivima „Gospodine, smiluj se. Kriste, smiluj se“, zatim „Kriste, čuj nas. Kriste, usliši nas“ te zazivima Ocu nebeskom, Sinu Otkupitelju svijeta, Duhu Svetom i Svetom Trojstvu.

Nakon toga slijedi dugačak niz zaziva koji počinju riječima „Milosrđe Božje“. Svi završavaju istim odgovorom: **„uzdam se u tebe“**. Zazivi zajedno opisuju milosrđe kroz cijelu povijest spasenja i kroz sve životne situacije. Božje milosrđe u njima se naziva:

- „neshvatljivom tajnom Presvetoga Trojstva“ i „izrazom njegove najveće moći“,
- milosrđem koje se objavilo u stvaranju nebeskih duhova i koje je ljude „iz ništavila pozvalo u život“,
- milosrđem koje obuhvaća čitav svijet, daruje besmrtan život i štiti od zasluženih kazni,
- milosrđem koje oslobađa od bijede grijeha i koje se izlijeva iz rana Kristovih i iz Presvetoga Srca,
- milosrđem koje je ljudima dalo Presvetu Djevicu za majku milosrđa,
- milosrđem vidljivim u ustanovljenju Crkve i svetih sakramenata, „neograničenim“ u krštenju i pokori te „neizmjernim“ u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva,
- milosrđem koje poziva na vjeru, obraća grešnike, posvećuje pravednike i usavršuje svete.

Veliki dio litanija posvećen je onima koji pate. Milosrđe se zaziva kao „vrelo bolesnicima i patnicima“, „utjeha i blago“ onih skršena srca, „ufanje onih koji očajavaju“ i „mir umirućih“. Zazivi sežu i dalje od zemaljskog života: milosrđe „čuva od paklenoga ognja“, „olakšava patnje dušama u čistilištu“ i „slast je i neizmjerna radost svih svetih“.

Litanije završavaju zazivima milosrđa kao „beskrajnog u svim tajnama vjere“ i „neiscrpivog izvora čudesa“. Na kraju je psalamski redak: „Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srdžbu i pun dobrote. Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“
sections.subtitle_en: Litany of Divine Mercy: from creation to purgatory
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host leads the Litany of Divine Mercy and repeats "I trust in You"
sections.content_en:
At 12 minutes and 33 seconds, the **Litany of Divine Mercy** begins. It opens with the classic invocations "Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy," then "Christ, hear us. Christ, graciously hear us," and invocations to the heavenly Father, the Son Redeemer of the world, the Holy Spirit, and the Holy Trinity.

After that follows a long series of invocations that begin with the words "Divine Mercy." All end with the same response: **"I trust in you"**. The invocations together describe mercy throughout the entire history of salvation and through all life situations. Divine mercy is named in them as:

- the "incomprehensible mystery of the Most Holy Trinity" and "the expression of His greatest power",
- mercy that manifested itself in the creation of heavenly spirits and that called people "out of nothingness into life",
- mercy that embraces the entire world, bestows immortal life, and protects from deserved punishments,
- mercy that liberates from the misery of sin and that flows from the wounds of Christ and from the Sacred Heart,
- mercy that gave people the Blessed Virgin as mother of mercy,
- mercy visible in the institution of the Church and holy sacraments, "unlimited" in baptism and penance and "immeasurable" in the sacrament of the altar and priesthood,
- mercy that calls to faith, converts sinners, sanctifies the righteous, and perfects the saints.

A large part of the litany is dedicated to those who suffer. Mercy is invoked as the "source for the sick and suffering," "consolation and treasure" of the brokenhearted, "hope of those who despair," and "peace of the dying." The invocations extend even beyond earthly life: mercy "guards from the fire of hell," "relieves the suffering of souls in purgatory," and is the "sweetness and immense joy of all the saints."

The litany concludes with invocations of mercy as "boundless in all mysteries of faith" and "an inexhaustible source of miracles." At the end is the psalm verse: "God is merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger and full of goodness. Therefore I will sing of the mercy of God forever."

sections.subtitle: Završna molitva: da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj poziva „Pomolimo se“ i izgovara završnu molitvu vječnom Bogu milosrđa
sections.content:
Pobožnost milosrđu zaključuje se zbornom molitvom koju voditelj uvodi riječima „Pomolimo se“. Vječnom se Bogu obraća kao onome čije je milosrđe „neistraživo“ i čije je „blago smilovanja neiscrpivo“.

Molba je izrazito pastoralna. Bog se moli da u vjernicima umnoži svoje milosrđe, kako u **teškim trenucima ne bi očajavali niti bili obeshrabreni**. Umjesto toga, moli se da se s velikim pouzdanjem predaju Njegovoj svetoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje“.

Molitva završava po Isusu Kristu, kojeg naziva **„kraljem milosrđa“** i koji „s Ocem i Duhom Svetim iskazuje milosrđe u sve vijeke vjekova“. Time se zatvara prvi, dvadesetak minuta dug dio emisije, posvećen isključivo Božjem milosrđu.
sections.subtitle_en: Concluding prayer: that in difficult moments we do not despair
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host invites "Let us pray" and speaks the concluding prayer to the eternal God of mercy
sections.content_en:
The devotion to mercy concludes with the collect prayer which the host introduces with the words "Let us pray." The eternal God is addressed as the One whose mercy is "unfathomable" and whose "treasury of compassion is inexhaustible."

The petition is distinctly pastoral. God is asked to multiply His mercy in believers, so that in **difficult moments they may neither despair nor be discouraged**. Instead, it is prayed that with great confidence they may surrender to His holy will, "which is love and mercy itself."

The prayer concludes through Jesus Christ, whom he calls the **"King of Mercy"** and who "with the Father and the Holy Spirit shows mercy for ever and ever." With this closes the first, roughly twenty-minute-long part of the broadcast, dedicated exclusively to Divine Mercy.

sections.subtitle: Gospina krunica, otajstva svjetla: Jordan i svadba u Kani
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje Gospinu krunicu i prvo otajstvo – krštenje na rijeci Jordanu
sections.content:
Na 16. minuti i 54. sekundi voditelj najavljuje: **„Slijedi Gospina krunica.“** Moli se otajstva svjetla, koja prate javno djelovanje Isusa Krista.

**Prvo otajstvo** glasi: „Koji je na rijeci Jordanu kršten bio.“ Svaka desetica ima isti, ustaljeni red:

- Očenaš,
- deset Zdravomarija,
- Slava Ocu,
- molitva „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe, očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja, dovedi u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.“

Posljednji zaziv, koji se moli na kraju svake desetice, povezuje Gospinu krunicu s prethodnom pobožnošću. I ovdje se završava molbom za milosrđe, i to za one kojima je ono „najpotrebnije“.

**Drugo otajstvo**, koje počinje na 20. minuti i 49. sekundi, glasi: „Koji je na svadbi u Kani objavio svoju slavu.“ Voditelj ga moli istim mirnim ritmom kao i prvo. Molitva se ne prekida komentarima ni tumačenjima. Cijeli prostor ostavljen je ponavljanju Zdravomarije i razmatranju otajstva.
sections.subtitle_en: Our Lady's Rosary, luminous mysteries: the Jordan and the wedding at Cana
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces Our Lady's Rosary and the first mystery – the baptism in the Jordan River
sections.content_en:
At 16 minutes and 54 seconds, the host announces: **"Our Lady's Rosary follows."** The luminous mysteries are prayed, which follow the public ministry of Jesus Christ.

**The first mystery** reads: "Who was baptized in the Jordan River." Each decade has the same, established order:

- Our Father,
- ten Hail Marys,
- Glory Be to the Father,
- the prayer "O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to heaven, especially those who are most in need of your mercy."

The final invocation, which is prayed at the end of each decade, connects Our Lady's Rosary with the preceding devotion. Here too, it ends with a plea for mercy, specifically for those who are "most in need" of it.

**The second mystery**, which begins at 20 minutes and 49 seconds, reads: "Who manifested his glory at the wedding at Cana." The host prays it with the same calm rhythm as the first. The prayer is not interrupted by comments or interpretations. The entire space is left to the repetition of the Hail Mary and the contemplation of the mystery.

sections.subtitle: Od poziva na obraćenje do euharistije: preostala tri otajstva svjetla
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje peto otajstvo svjetla – ustanovljenje svete euharistije na posljednjoj večeri
sections.content:
**Treće otajstvo**, na 24. minuti i 50. sekundi, sadrži Isusov navještaj: „Koji je navijestio: ‘Obratite se, kraljevstvo Božje je blizu.’“ Tema obraćenja provlači se kroz cijelu epizodu i već se pojavila u litanijama, gdje se milosrđe zazivalo „u obraćenju grešnika“.

**Četvrto otajstvo**, koje počinje na 28. minuti i 49. sekundi, posvećeno je preobraženju: „Koji se na gori Taboru preobrazio.“

**Peto otajstvo**, na 32. minuti i 42. sekundi, zaključuje niz otajstava svjetla: „Koji je na posljednjoj večeri ustanovio svetu euharistiju.“ To se povezuje sa zazivom iz litanija u kojem se milosrđe naziva „neizmjernim u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva“.

I ova tri otajstva voditelj moli bez prekida i dodatnih objašnjenja. Svako završava doksologijom „Slava Ocu i Sinu i Duhu Svetomu“ i molitvom „O moj Isuse“. Nakon petog otajstva krunica završava.
sections.subtitle_en: From the call to conversion to the Eucharist: the remaining three luminous mysteries
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the fifth luminous mystery – the institution of the holy Eucharist at the Last Supper
sections.content_en:
**The third mystery**, at 24 minutes and 50 seconds, contains Jesus' proclamation: "Who proclaimed: 'Repent, the kingdom of God is at hand.'" The theme of conversion runs through the entire episode and already appeared in the litany, where mercy was invoked "in the conversion of sinners."

**The fourth mystery**, which begins at 28 minutes and 49 seconds, is dedicated to the transfiguration: "Who was transfigured on Mount Tabor."

**The fifth mystery**, at 32 minutes and 42 seconds, concludes the series of luminous mysteries: "Who instituted the holy Eucharist at the Last Supper." This connects with the invocation from the litany in which mercy is called "immeasurable in the sacrament of the altar and priesthood."

The host prays these three mysteries as well without interruption and additional explanations. Each ends with the doxology "Glory be to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit" and the prayer "O my Jesus." After the fifth mystery, the rosary ends.

sections.subtitle: „Zdravo Kraljice“: vapaj prognanih sinova Evinih
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli završnu marijansku antifonu „Zdravo Kraljice, majko milosrđa“
sections.content:
Molitveni dio emisije zatvara se drevnom marijanskom molitvom **„Zdravo Kraljice“**. Ona se dobro nadovezuje na temu dana, jer Mariju odmah u prvom retku naziva **„majkom milosrđa“**, uz „život, slast i ufanje naše“.

Vjernici se u molitvi predstavljaju kao „prognani sinovi Evini“ koji vapiju i uzdišu „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini“. Mariju mole kao zagovornicu da na njih svrne „svoje milostive oči“ i da im „poslije ovoga progona“ pokaže Isusa, „blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje“.

Molitva završava trostrukim nježnim zazivom: **„O blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo.“** Time završava gotovo 37 minuta dug molitveni blok, koji je obuhvatio zaštitne molitve, posvete, Krunicu i Litanije Božjem milosrđu te Gospinu krunicu. Nakon njega slijedi tumačenje Svete riječi.
sections.subtitle_en: "Hail, Holy Queen": the cry of the banished children of Eve
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the concluding Marian antiphon "Hail, Holy Queen, mother of mercy"
sections.content_en:
The prayer part of the broadcast closes with the ancient Marian prayer **"Hail, Holy Queen"**. It ties in well with the theme of the day, because in the very first line it calls Mary **"mother of mercy"**, along with "our life, our sweetness, and our hope."

In the prayer, believers present themselves as "banished children of Eve" who cry and sigh "mourning and weeping in this valley of tears." They pray to Mary as an intercessor to turn "her merciful eyes" toward them and, "after this our exile," show them Jesus, "the blessed fruit of her womb."

The prayer ends with a threefold gentle invocation: **"O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary."** This ends the almost 37-minute-long prayer block, which encompassed prayers of protection, consecrations, the Chaplet and Litany of Divine Mercy, and Our Lady's Rosary. Following it is the interpretation of the Holy Word.
